climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Müller-Thurgau, Pinot Gris and Pinot Noir sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Lorraine appellation on the Moselle river. Moselle wines in general are mainly white and come from some of the coldest climates used for commercial winemaking. The French rules allow Müller-Thurgau, Auxerrois, Pinot Gris and Pinot Noir as main grapes.
